# WWII Journal, Volume 1

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
source("R/proofread.R")
source("R/book_helpers.R")
final <- apply_corrections()
vol <- "vol1"
```

Source file: `vol1.pdf`. The WWII volume number is not yet confirmed.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-status
#| tbl-cap: "Review status of this volume."
volume_status(final) |> filter(volume == vol) |> kable()
```

The text below is published only after review. Until then the chunk is switched off. To publish, change `eval: false` to `eval: true` in the chunk and render. Pages that still show `ocr_draft` in the status table are unreviewed OCR, and `[?word]` marks flag words that were not resolved.

```{r}
#| label: transcription
#| eval: false
#| results: asis
cat(volume_markdown(final, vol))
```
